name: IrregularIncome

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on budget planning.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on planning the budget and discussing future expenses and savings.

variations.context: Building a savings plan from irregular income

setting.relationship_dynamic: Friends discussing finances with variable monthly earnings
setting.background: Income changes from month to month

scenario_template.topic: Comparing good and bad income months
scenario_template.note: They discuss why a fixed monthly budget is difficult

scenario_template.topic: Overspending during high-income months and feeling squeezed during low-income months
scenario_template.note: They want a system that smooths out fluctuations

scenario_template.topic: Creating a budget based on variable income
scenario_template.note: They ask how to decide what amount is safe to spend

scenario_template.topic: Separating baseline expenses from flexible spending and savings
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps them create a buffer for lower-income periods

scenario_template.topic: Deciding how to allocate income above the baseline
scenario_template.note: They discuss savings, future expenses, and discretionary spending
Assistant helps them draw from their buffer strategically

scenario_template.topic: Agreeing on a variable-income budgeting system
scenario_template.note: They feel less dependent on predicting exact monthly income

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to manage their finances more effectively but has limited experience with budgeting and can become overwhelmed when faced with many expenses, financial categories, competing priorities, or unexpected costs.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help track and plan finances, but tends to overthink spending decisions, double-check calculations, and seek confirmation when deciding how to allocate money across competing needs.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Budget planning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for organizing expenses, setting spending priorities, creating realistic budgets, and tracking progress, while suggesting alternatives when income, savings goals, recurring costs, or unexpected expenses constrain the available budget.
